blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving from altitudes up to 17,500 feet MSL with USPA-rated instructors. The jump includes a scenic plane ride, freefall, and a 3-5 minute canopy flight before landing. Experienced jumpers can jump from 13,500 feet AGL in a 10-seat Piper Navajo aircraft.
extraNote: Deposits are non-refundable but transferable or can be used as a rain check · No jumps in rain or through clouds; weather decisions made on jump day · Stevensville Airport, 30 minutes from Missoula
